title: VoxelCore skeleton
description: Entity skeleton (<pack>/skeletons/<name>.json, id pack:name), parsed by SkeletonConfig::parse (src/animation/rigging.cpp).

name.markdownDescription:
name of the element to get the index (optional field)

[Documentation](https://github.com/MihailRis/VoxelCore/blob/main/doc/en/rigging.md#skeletons)
name.description: name of the element to get the index (optional field)

model.markdownDescription:
name of the model to display the element (optional field)

Model name (`models/` folder of a pack; vcm, obj or vec3).

[Documentation](https://github.com/MihailRis/VoxelCore/blob/main/doc/en/rigging.md#skeletons)
model.description:

offset.markdownDescription:

Default: `[0, 0, 0]`.
